```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
# ---- config ----
pt <- params$patient_id

if (grepl("^\\d+$", pt)) {
  steinbock_dir <- paste0("/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/steinbock/p",
                          pt, "_results/")
} else {
  steinbock_dir <- paste0("/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/steinbock/",
                          pt, "/")
}

coord_cols <- c("Start_push", "End_push", "Pushes_duration", "X", "Y", "Z")

markers_of_interest <- c(
  "SMA", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD19", "CD15", "CD14", "CD86", "LAMP3",
  "Ki67", "CD138", "PD1", "PDL1", "FoxP3", "CD68", "CD163", "TIM3",
  "CD141", "CD11c", "CD56", "CD117", "EpCAM", "CD38", "CD45RO",
  "MKI67", "LAG3", "CD1c"
)
```

```{r}
# ---- load_and_sample ----
filtered_dir <- file.path(steinbock_dir, "filtered/")
txt_files    <- list.files(filtered_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
pixels <- map_dfr(seq_along(txt_files), function(i) {
  df          <- read_tsv(txt_files[i], show_col_types = FALSE)
  marker_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), coord_cols)
  df[sample(nrow(df), min(50000, nrow(df))), marker_cols] |>
    mutate(ROI = paste0("ROI_", i))
})

colnames(pixels) <- str_replace(colnames(pixels), "\\(.*\\)$", "")
```

```{r}
# ---- reshape ----
pixels_long <- pixels |>
  pivot_longer(-ROI, names_to = "marker", values_to = "intensity") |>
  mutate(intensity_asinh = asinh(intensity / 1))
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
# ---- histogram_grid ----
ggplot(pixels_long, aes(x = intensity_asinh)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "white",
                 linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free", ncol = 5) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Patient ", pt, " — Pixel intensity landscape"),
    subtitle = "asinh(intensity / 1), 50k pixels sampled per ROI",
    x        = "asinh(intensity)",
    y        = "Pixel count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 7)
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- sparsity_table ----
marker_summary <- pixels_long |>
  group_by(marker) |>
  summarise(
    median_asinh = round(median(intensity_asinh), 2),
    pct_zero     = round(mean(intensity == 0) * 100, 2),
    max_asinh    = round(max(intensity_asinh), 2),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_zero))

knitr::kable(
  marker_summary,
  caption   = paste0("Patient ", pt, " — marker intensity and sparsity (asinh-transformed)"),
  col.names = c("Marker", "Median asinh", "% Zero", "Max asinh")
)
```

```{r}
# ---- build_three_source_df ----
markers_present <- intersect(markers_of_interest, unique(pixels_long$marker))

pixels_three <- pixels_long |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_present) |>
  select(ROI, marker, intensity) |>
  mutate(source = "raw_pixel") |>
  bind_rows(
    pixels_long |>
      filter(marker %in% markers_present) |>
      select(ROI, marker, intensity) |>
      mutate(source = "scaled_0to100")
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    pixels_long |>
      filter(marker %in% markers_present) |>
      select(ROI, marker, intensity) |>
      mutate(intensity = asinh(intensity / 1),
             source    = "scaled_asinh")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# ---- plot_pixel_distributions ----
source_colors <- c(
  "raw_pixel"     = "#4E79A7",
  "scaled_0to100" = "#F28E2B",
  "scaled_asinh"  = "#59A14F"
)
source_labels <- c(
  "raw_pixel"     = "Raw pixel",
  "scaled_0to100" = "Filtered (0-100)",
  "scaled_asinh"  = "Filtered asinh"
)

for (m in markers_present) {
  plot_df <- pixels_three |> filter(marker == m)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df,
              aes(x = intensity, fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, scales = "free", nrow = 1,
               labeller = labeller(source = source_labels)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = source_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = source_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Patient ", pt, "  |  ", m, "  — pixel-level"),
      x     = "Intensity",
      y     = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p)
}
```
